fields.summary: Autonomous plan of change set 01M7NVMX (rhiza.daemon.maxRuns=auto) by the conductor of run 01M7QXF341135P9DZCYWE4XJVE; no owner was present. The owner's choice of an auto setting is milestone 40's Decision m40-maxruns-auto. Research: the daemon reads rhiza.daemon.maxRuns as a whole number (daemonConfOf, internal/api/daemon_settings.go), fills the machine-wide slots round-robin up to it (daemon.RoundRobin, internal/api/daemon.go), and its pre-start checks are the load/memory machine hold, the tmp-low hold and the repo's disk-low check, which already stop every start while one holds. The conductor ruled, by derivation from the intent and the code: auto lets the poll start one more run than are running when every pre-start check has room and none when any holds, so each further start waits for the next poll's readings; the default stays 2 and a number still pins the cap; rhiza.project.maxRuns and the --max-runs flag stay whole numbers; daemon status and health name auto instead of a fixed cap. Three leaves: the setting accepts auto, the poll applies it, status and health show it.
fields.title: maxRuns=auto leaves, planned by the conductor
